title: The JA Diner j6 1.0.8 kit declares its home colour variants and account screens as stock screens
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The committed kit names /home/*, /password-reset and /username-reminder-request, each with a reason.
Those match exactly the four home colour variants and the two account screens; the home page and the kept pages are not stock screens.

tests: the JA Diner 1.0.8 kit declares its stock screens with a reason each and no problem
the stock screens are the home colour variants and the two account screens, and the home page is not one
a plan that keeps the home page has the write step drop exactly the stock screens
